meaning_translation.Japanese: 何かについて心配で少し不安な状態

meaning_translation.Japanese: 悪いことが起こるかもしれないと心配すること

translation.Hindi: मुझे भूख लगी है। चलो खाना खाते हैं।

translation.Hindi: वह बीमार है और बिस्तर पर है।
translation.Japanese: 彼は具合が悪くて寝ています。

grammar_tips.title: Using 'I feel' and 'I am' with adjectives
grammar_tips.explanation: Use 'I feel + adjective' or 'I am + adjective' to describe emotions: I feel happy. / I am tired.

explanation_translation.Hindi: 'I feel + adjective' या 'I am + adjective' से भावनाएँ बताइए: I feel happy. / I am tired.
explanation_translation.Japanese: 感情は「I feel + 形容詞」または「I am + 形容詞」で表します: I feel happy. / I am tired.

grammar_tips.title: Asking about feelings
grammar_tips.explanation: Use 'How do you feel?' or 'How are you feeling?' to ask about emotions.

explanation_translation.Hindi: भावनाएँ पूछने के लिए 'How do you feel?' या 'How are you feeling?' कहें।
explanation_translation.Japanese: 感情を尋ねるときは「How do you feel?」「How are you feeling?」を使います。

grammar_tips.title: Degree words: very / a little / really
grammar_tips.explanation: Add degree words before adjectives: 'very tired', 'a little nervous', 'really happy'.

explanation_translation.Hindi: विशेषण से पहले 'very/a little/really' लगाएँ: 'very tired', 'a little nervous', 'really happy'.
explanation_translation.Japanese: 形容詞の前に程度を表す語を置きます: 'very tired', 'a little nervous', 'really happy'.

grammar_tips.title: Giving reasons with 'because'
grammar_tips.explanation: Use 'because' to explain: 'I am sad because I lost my phone.'

explanation_translation.Hindi: कारण बताने के लिए 'because' का प्रयोग करें: 'I am sad because I lost my phone.'
explanation_translation.Japanese: 理由を説明するには 'because' を使います: 'I am sad because I lost my phone.'
